claims.content: C2 JU
Surveillance data reporting is initiated by the JU which first detects or initiates a track/point and makes it available for reporting on the interface.
Each track/point initiated and reported shall be assigned a TN from the JU's allocated block, and at that time, the JU shall have R2 for the track/point.
Standard identity is provided in terms of definitions including Pending, Unknown, Assumed Friend, Friend, Neutral, Suspect, and Hostile.
Track identity as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1 is exchanged.

For each of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields which are implemented by a C2 JU, the JU shall accept all defined field values for retransmission and operator appreciation, in the event of assuming R2 for a previously-reported track.
PPLI data available from J2 messages shall be used by C2 JUs to reduce the redundancy of surveillance track reporting.
A C2 JU participating on the Surveillance Network PG shall attempt to correlate received PPLI reports with data being received from local sensors.

Notwithstanding standard requirements, a C2 JU may elect to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.

Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted if the JU assumes R2, unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for the field which differs from the value accepted for retransmission, in which case the JU shall report the locally derived data.

As an exception to local data reporting, non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R2.

When a Platform, Platform Activity or Specific Type value of 0, No Statement, is received and a non-zero value is held locally, the standard rule for retaining received values during remote ID change acceptance does not apply.

When an Air Platform value of 6, Tanker, 7, Tanker (Boom Only), or 8, Tanker (Drogue Only) is held locally and a different value is received, the standard rule for retaining received values during remote ID change acceptance does not apply.

Differences in the Environment/Category, ID, Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, Exercise Indicator and Special Interest Indicator field values may also be resolved with the use of the J7.0 (ACT = 2) message.

If the two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict, C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate the two tracks (unless an operator selectable capability inhibits this restriction).

If the two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local Mode II code is current, C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate the two tracks (unless an operator selectable capability inhibits this restriction).
If both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks (i.e., being updated with local positional data), C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate the two tracks.
If either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1, C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate the two tracks (unless the Strength is set to No Statement).
If a correlation is not found, the received J2 PPLI report is integrated into the surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.
If decorrelation criteria are met, the PPLI and local track data are decorrelated and a surveillance track report is initiated with locally held data using a new track number.
After decorrelation, the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field are reported as No Statement.
When assuming R² of an IU, the IU is reported as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG.
When assuming R² of an IU, the Identity is reported as Friend.
When assuming R² of an IU, the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator are reported as value 1.
The Exercise Indicator is set in the J3 track messages to distinguish between live tracks involved in an exercise and other live tracks.
When the Exercise Indicator is set to value 0, the standard identity of the track is specified in the Identity field.
